meet_name: Lewiston High School Track Meet (Lewiston, Leavitt, Waterville, Skowhegan, Gardiner, Oak Hill)
notes: Source is a meet packet: 24 heat-sheet events (lane, athlete, team, a blank-filled mark) then field-event lists. No places, team scores or grades are printed. The heat-sheet marks look like entry/seed times (e.g. Leavitt boys 1600 race walk Fitzsimmons 7:35.1, boys 100 Jordan 11.4 in a heat where others ran 13+), but the file gives no other marks, so they are copied as the results. Places are NOT printed: place was computed by ranking marks across all heats of an event (ties share a place; field events by best mark). Rows are listed by place, not file order. 'Scratch' rows (no mark) are left out. Team names normalised: Gardner->Gardiner, Showhegan->Skowhegan, Oak Hills->Oak Hill; no school codes in file. Athlete names kept as printed incl. apparent typos (Champange, MacGregro, Pornuksam/Pornsuksam, Fershetian). Event names normalised: Racewalk->Race Walk, Discuss->Discus, 'Pault Vault'->Pole Vault; '4 x 400 Relay' = 4x400 Meter Relay. Relay athletes not listed. Field marks: 3/4, 1/2, 1/4 inches written as decimals (e.g. 30'3"3/4 -> 30-03.75); '78’' -> 78-00. Boys Shot Put 'Thayne Sherburne 27"1"1/2' read as 27-01.5 (typo for 27'1"1/2). Girls Shot Put 'Brittany Smith 2212"1/2' is unreadable (22'1 1/2? 22'12 1/2?) and left as printed with place null (the same athlete threw 42-05.5 in discus). Girls High Jump/Pole Vault and Boys equivalents: '- Nth Attempt' suffix dropped. Boys Pole Vault Kyle Norway 'Passed at 7' & 7'6" - Failed at 8'' has no cleared height: written NH with place null. 'FAULT OUT' (Ashley Beauparlant, Mariah Duncan; Ryan Fitzsimmons 'Fault Out') written FOUL with place null. Girls Pole Vault: Duperry 6'6" 3rd attempt and Lefebvre 8'6" are as printed. Boys 3200 marks have no tenths (10:44 etc.). Boys Long Jump Hassan Abdinoor/Nolan MacDonnell appear out of school grouping at the end of the list; kept. Boys Discus 'Andrew Jackson Lewiston' and Shot 'Jackson Lewiston 31-08' (surname only) kept as printed. Heat 1 of boys 400 has a stray 'Scratch' on the header line, ignored. Meet date from title (April 17, 2008). [review] unreadable shot mark left out. [review] places were computed, not printed: removed.
